tools.name: list_insurers
tools.description: List tracked U.S. health insurers with whether verified CMS-0057-F prior-authorization metrics are available for each.

tools.name: get_insurer_metrics
tools.description: Get an insurer's verified CY2025 prior-authorization metrics (denial rate, appeal overturn rate, decision times) from its own CMS-0057-F disclosure, plus contract/plan-level rows where collected. Includes source URLs and scope notes.

tools.name: rank_denial_rates
tools.description: Insurer prior-authorization denial rates (CY2025), ranked only within compatible reporting cohorts. Each row includes its cohort, rank within that cohort, exact source scope, calculation method, and source link. Never compare ranks across cohorts.

tools.name: get_treatment_outcomes
tools.description: External-review outcomes for a treatment: how often insurer denials of this treatment/drug/procedure were overturned by independent reviewers (42,749 published CA IMR decisions, 2001–2026). Accepts a category slug (e.g. 'pharmacy') or specific treatment slug (e.g. 'zepbound', 'speech-therapy').

tools.name: get_condition_outcomes
tools.description: External-review outcomes for a medical condition: how often insurance denials involving this condition were overturned, plus the most-fought treatments for it.

tools.name: search_outcomes
tools.description: Search treatments (categories + specific drugs/procedures) and conditions by name. Returns slugs for get_treatment_outcomes / get_condition_outcomes plus headline overturn rates.

tools.name: get_appeal_rights
tools.description: Deterministically resolve the governing appeal route, missing facts, filing recipient, deadlines, current external-review status, and verified grounds. Distinguishes Original Medicare, Medicare Advantage medical benefits, Part D pharmacy benefits, employer funding/governance, ACA, Medicaid, FEHB, TR

tools.name: get_drug_playbook
tools.description: Drug-specific denial patterns and appeal strategy for the medications plans fight hardest over: GLP-1s (Wegovy, Zepbound, Mounjaro, Ozempic, Saxenda) and IBD biologics (Humira, Skyrizi, Stelara, Entyvio, Remicade, Rinvoq). tools.name: get_state_external_review
tools.description: How a state's external review process works: filing deadline, regulator contact, and key facts. Verified detail currently covers 10 states (CA, TX, FL, NY, PA, IL, OH, GA, NC, MI); other states return the covered list.

findings.detail: Tool "rank_denial_rates" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Ranked table of insurer prior-authorization denial rates (CY2025) from each insurer's own public CMS-0057-F disclosure, with appeal overturn rates and source links. Scope varies by insurer — read the notes." → after: "Insurer prior-authorization denial rates (CY2025), ranked only within compatible reporting cohorts. Each row includes its cohort, rank within that cohort, exact source scope, calculation method, and source link. Never compare ranks across cohorts."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
